answer_1.quote: Paraphrasing is the task of reconstructing sentences with different words and phrases while maintaining semantic meaning when a source sentence is given.

answer_2.quote: To measure the performance of paraphrase systems, we used Quora Question Pairs (QQP) test data ... and measure the semantic, diversity, and fluency scores of paraphrases. ... diversity uses Isacreblue (inverser-sacrebleu). ... The semantic score is measured ... using Bleurt. ... When measuring Fluency, GPT2-small is used as a language model.
